scope: Original two-colour jersey treatments in the shared canonical collectible renderer. No logos or copied uniform artwork.
footballRetention: 20 current club identities and Burnley, West Ham United, Wolverhampton Wanderers retained for existing cards. This catalogue does not determine competition eligibility.
palettePolicy: Docked colour interpretations, not certified official hex specifications or season-specific kit replicas. Existing explicit colour snapshots take precedence; NFL palettes unchanged.
mapping: Match exact sport-scoped canonical ID (e.g. afl:ade), code (ADE), team name or documented alias. Numeric provider IDs must first be mapped. No fuzzy city matching. Unknown clubs remain neutral. City and jersey number still require explicit metadata.
integration: jerseyPresentation is used by PlayerJersey inside the shared CollectibleFace. The catalogue supplies defaults only when an explicit saved primary colour is absent. Existing historical colours are not rewritten. Scraper/roster mapping can reuse exported teamColourCatalogue primary/accent values in reviewed presentation metadata; no roster import is performed by this change.

checks.browser: 12 sport/viewport combinations, all 88 palettes checked at 360, 412 and 1440 pixels; fill, trim, number, overflow and page errors checked
checks.visualInspection: AFL complete desktop gallery and mobile screenshots for all four sports inspected
checks.fixtureIsolation: Local browser fixture only, fictional player names, no database or member mutations
checks.limitations: No physical device or hosted acceptance run. No clean build or full platform suite rerun for this presentation-only change. Production unchanged. New sport live rosters and feed mapping remain separate release requirements.
